findings.summary: the git-compound hook wedged when stdin never closed (issue #214 class, wired to every Bash call) — measured never-exiting at 5s while the sibling hook exits at 2s. Fixed with the sibling's settle-on-deadline pattern; the watchdog DECIDES ON WHAT ARRIVED, so a dangerous payload is still denied. Observed: terminated=false red without the watchdog, terminated+denied green with it.

newline is a command separator and the regex treated it as prose — the false-negative hole covered the routine multi-line Bash shape, and the comment's claimed heredoc residual did not exist for the same reason. \n added to both separator classes; 4 newline-chain deny cases observed red pre-fix.
git -C <dir> checkout && tail defeated the anchor (subcommand required immediately after git). Global-flag skip added, deny case observed both ways.
mutations:[null] threw a TypeError instead of producing a finding; null-entry guard + selftest case (63/63).

env/time/VAR=-prefixed and quoted branch switches pass the anchor — documented as accepted residuals in the hook header; a shell parser, not a regex, would be needed. Deliberate: the hook is a guardrail, not a jail.

the PR body claimed 'hook selftest red 5/5 under a gutted deny'; the shipped selftest carried 4 deny cases. Post-fix tally: 8 deny cases, 10 FAILs observed under a gutted deny. Corrected here per ADR-0070's own corollary.

FIX-INTRODUCED by round 1's newline fix, disclosed per ADR-0070 §4: the \n tail alternation matched an empty tail, so a bare switch with a trailing newline — the deny message's own prescribed remedy — was denied. Tail now requires content; three trailing-newline allow cases observed red (3 FAILs) under the reverted lookahead, anchor asserted before substituting.
the guard's selftest was wired into no automated gate; now a review-gate.yml step mirroring the sibling durable-claim Brake's.

the record's mutation tallies each counted the selftest's own FAILED banner (grep -c artifact): honest counts are 9 (gutted deny: 8 deny cases + watchdog) and 3 (newline classes). Second tally correction on this PR; both on the record.

--git-dir/--no-pager long flags and -C "path with space" pass the flag skip — documented as accepted residuals in the header alongside env/time/VAR=/quoted (a shell parser, not a regex, would be needed).
